headline: Toffees And Tractor Boys Split The Loyalties
deck: Everton v Ipswich splits two live ties: test3's Pickford and Emersonn face test31121's Akpom, and test31's trio meet testf's Tarkowski.
body:
Two ties come to this fixture level and leave it changed. test3 and test31121 sit locked at nil apiece, and both have skin in it: Pickford and Emersonn stand for test3, Akpom for test31121. A clean sheet one way, a striker's afternoon the other, and a tie that has refused to move all week finally does.

The second front is heavier one-sided. testf lead test31 by two with only Tarkowski in the fixture, and against him test31 field three: Mykolenko, Dewsbury-Hall and Barry. Numbers on one side, the scoring defender on the other. Lukić, the Clarke-Fatawu-Enciso cluster and Röhl are all in the ninety minutes too, watching a match that owes them nothing but can still take something.
